questions.question:
The data given below shows the marks obtained by various students.

 
 

 
 
Marks

 
 
 
Number of students

 
 
 

 
 
10 – 12 

 
 
 
6

 
 
 

 
 
12 – 14 

 
 
 
8

 
 
 

 
 
14 – 16

 
 
 
5

 
 
 

 
 
16 – 18 

 
 
 
7

 
 
 

 
 
18 - 20 

 
 
 
4

 
 
 

 

What is the mean marks (Correct up to two decimal places) of given data?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use assumed mean (A) = 15.

Deviations (d = x − A) are −4, −2, 0, 2, 4 for the respective class mid-points.

Net deviation = 6 × (−4) + 8 × (−2) + 5 × 0 + 7 × 2 + 4 × 4 = −10.

Average deviation = −10 ÷ 30 = −0.33.

Actual Mean = 15 − 0.33 = 14.67.

**∴ The correct answer is 14.67.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Class intervals and corresponding frequencies representing marks of students.

**Formula Used:**

Mean = Σ(f × x) ÷ Σf

Where x = Mid-point of class interval = (Lower limit + Upper limit) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ For 10 − 12: x = 11, f = 6 → f × x = 66

⇒ For 12 − 14: x = 13, f = 8 → f × x = 104

⇒ For 14 − 16: x = 15, f = 5 → f × x = 75

⇒ For 16 − 18: x = 17, f = 7 → f × x = 119

⇒ For 18 − 20: x = 19, f = 4 → f × x = 76

⇒ Total Frequency (Σf) = 6 + 8 + 5 + 7 + 4 = 30

⇒ Total Sum Σ(f × x) = 66 + 104 + 75 + 119 + 76 = 440

⇒ Mean = 440 ÷ 30 = 44 ÷ 3

⇒ Mean = 14.666...

⇒ Rounding to two decimal places = 14.67

**∴ The correct answer is 14.67.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Mean Method

Mean = Σ(f × x) ÷ Σf, where x is the mid-point of the class interval and f is the frequency. It is best used when numerical values of x and f are small.

Assumed Mean Method

Mean = A + [Σ(f × d) ÷ Σf], where A is the assumed mean and d = x − A. This heavily simplifies calculations when values of x and f are large.

Step-Deviation Method

Mean = A + h × [Σ(f × u) ÷ Σf], where u = (x − A) ÷ h and h is the common class width. This further reduces calculation complexity for grouped distributions.
</p

questions.question: A person goes from A to B with a speed of 30 km/h. He comes back from B to A with a speed of 20 km/h. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
questions.solution:
Average speed = 2xy/(x + y)

Here, x = speed from A to B

y = speed from B to A

⇒ Average = 2 × 30 × 20/(30 + 20)

⇒ Average = 24 km/h

∴ The average speed for the entire journey is 24 km/h.

questions.question: A train crosses a stationary pole in 3 minutes. It crosses a 600 meter long platform in 5 minutes. What are the length and the speed of the train?
questions.solution:
Let the speed and length of the train be x m/s and y m respectively.

If train crosses a stationary pole in 3 minutes,

Speed of the train = Total distance/Total time

⇒ Speed of the train = y/(3 × 60)

⇒ Speed of the train = y/180 ---- (1)

If train crosses 600 m long platform 5 minutes,

⇒ Speed of the train = (y + 600)/(5 × 60)

⇒ y/180 = (y + 600)/300

⇒ 5y = 3y + 1800

⇒ 2y = 1800

⇒ y = 900 m

From(1),

⇒ Speed of the train = 900/180 = 5 m/sec

⇒ Speed of the train = 5 × 18/5 = 18 km/h

∴ The length and the speed of the train are 900 m and 18 km/h respectively.

questions.question: If X : Y : Z = 1 : 2 : 3 and, X² + Y² + Z² = 224, then what is the value of X + Y + Z?
questions.solution:
Let the value of X, Y and Z be a, 2a and 3a

⇒ X² + Y² + Z² = 224

⇒ a² + (2a)² + (3a)² = 224

⇒ 14 a² = 224

⇒ a² = 16

⇒ a = 4

⇒ X + Y + Z = a + 2a + 3a = 6a = 24

∴ The value of (X + Y + Z) is 24.

questions.question: If Rs. 1000 is invested for two years at simple interest at the rate of 12.5% per annum, then what is the amount?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs 1000

Time = 2 years

Rate = 12.5% p.a

**Concept used:**

Amount = SI + P

SI = PRT/100

P → princiapl R → rate of interest T → time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Simple interest = (1000 × 12.5 × 2)/100

⇒ Simple interest = 250

⇒ Amount after 2 years = 1000 + 250 = Rs. 1250

**∴ The amount is Rs. 1250**.

Five technicians of a Studio A can do a work in 30 days. Eight technicians of a Studio B can do the same work in 15 days. In how many days can one technician of Studio A and one technician of Studio B, together do the same work?
questions.solution:
Number of technicians × studio A × days = Number of technicians × studio B × days

⇒ 5 × studio A × 30 = 8 × studio B × 15

⇒ 5 × studio A = 4 × studio B

⇒ Studio A/Studio B = 4/5

⇒ Time taken by one technician of studio A and one technician of studio B together to complete the work = (5 × 4 × 30)/(4 + 5)

⇒ Time taken by one technician of studio A and one technician of studio B together to complete the work = 200/3 days

∴ Total work will be done by one technician of studio A and one technician of studio B together in 200/3 days.

questions.question: If profit is 20% of the selling price, then profit is what percent of the cost price?
questions.solution:
Let the selling price be 100x

⇒ Profit = 20% of the selling price

⇒ Profit = 20% × 100x = 20x

⇒ Cost price = selling price – Profit

⇒ Cost price = 100x – 20x = 80x

⇒ Profit% on the cost price = (profit/cost price) × 100

⇒ Profit% on the cost price = (20x/80x) × 100

⇒ Profit% on the cost price = 25%

∴ Profit% on the cost price is 25%.
